description: TransLink - Major Road Network is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by TransLink. The Major Road Network (MRN) supports the safe and efficient movement of people and goods across the Metro Vancouver region. It includes more than 600 kilometres of major arterial roads that carry commuter, transit, and truck traffic. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher TransLink. Its tags are MRN, Translink, Transportation. It offers 3 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2021-11-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – TransLink. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
